per_candidate.id: s2:The Inhomogeneity Effect. II. Rotational and Orbital States Impact Planetary Cooling
s2:The Inhomogeneity Effect. III. Weather Impacts on the Heat Flow of Hot Jupiters

rationale: The papers 2501.06395, 2608.16988, and 2512.08932 investigate the heating mechanisms and thermal evolution of hot Jupiters, contributing evidence relevant to the relationship between incident flux and their observed sizes, but do not fully resolve the discrepancies in their anomalous radii.
